displayName: Niche 9: Y tế / Bác sĩ ẩn danh / Sinh tử và chăm sóc
description: Romance and thriller medical drama centered on hospital and clinic care: hidden surgeon authority, malpractice cover-up, VIP patient politics, consent and chart fraud, triage decisions, organ transplant ethics, ICU drama, ER night shift pressure, OR error reveal, hospice and end-of-life care, military combat medic, traditional medicine versus modern medicine, and ethics-board hospital justice. The engine is medical risk + chart-backed truth, not generic urban revenge (-> Niche 2) and not corporate paperwork (-> Niche 8).
emotionalAxis: life-care stakes, medical thriller pressure, hidden doctor authority, consent and chart truth, romance-adjacent care bond after the rescue, patient dignity, ethics-board reveal beyond personal apology

chapterArcDefaults.hookStyle: urgent care denial, medical blame, or ethics breach with concrete human stakes (a patient on the table, a family in the hallway)

humiliationPacing: triage desk shame: she is dismissed as a complainer, addict, or 'low-priority'
rich or VIP family overrides care workers and rewrites the chart pressure
malpractice cover-up or consent manipulation blames the wrong nurse / resident
a poor patient or migrant worker is treated as expendable on rounds
chart details slowly expose the abuse but are dismissed as a junior's mistake
the residency hierarchy silences the only person who saw the error
donor list, drug trial, or recall data is altered to protect a kickback partner
the hidden doctor is told to stay quiet because she is 'just' a nurse / resident / volunteer
the patient is asked to apologize for asking for a second opinion
revengeActivation: consent records and chart audit reveal the truth in the ethics review
hidden doctor authority lands after the harm is visible and documented
malpractice evidence reaches the licensing board, not just an internal apology
patient safety rule changes are written into hospital policy
the donor list / trial data / recall record is corrected on the public registry
the heroine protects care before status, refusing the easy 'forget it' settlement
the wrongly blamed nurse / resident is publicly recredited on rounds
the second opinion saves the patient and rewrites the chain of command
the whistleblower is protected on paper before any romance subplot resolves
dignityRecoveryTiming: late ethics review, medical-board reveal, or patient-rights public correction with chart evidence — never a private hush from the VIP family

belongsHere: hospital, clinic, ICU, ER, OR, hospice, rural clinic, disaster zone, combat field as venues
consent form, chart audit, donor list, trial data, recall registry as evidence
hidden doctor authority and second-opinion rescue arcs
ethics board, medical-licensing board, patient safety reform as resolution venue
romance arrives after the medical truth is documented, not before
doesNotBelongHere: office contract / paper marriage / hostile takeover (-> Niche 8)
rich-poor courtship without a hospital-care engine (-> Niche 1)
general urban humiliation without a medical wound (-> Niche 2)
